argv: cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; cat /proc/uptime; for d in /sys/class/power_supply/*; do echo "SUPPLY $d"; for p in type status present online capacity voltage_now current_now temp health usb_type voltage_max current_max; do if [ -r "$d/$p" ]; then printf "%s=" "$p"; cat "$d/$p"; fi; done; done; for z in /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*; do if [ "$(cat "$z/type" 2>/dev/null)" = sm5714-battery ] || [ "$z" = /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone37 ]; then echo "THERMAL $z"; for p in type mode temp; do printf "%s=" "$p"; cat "$z/$p" 2>&1; done; fi; done
